insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: ₹50 Lakhs to ₹6 Crores (as per Product Benefit Table)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room Rent ... Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP+), Hospitalization Treatment (In-built Cover)
great.explanation: Room rent is covered at actual cost up to the sum insured without any category restriction. This means you can choose any room type and the policy will pay the full eligible rent within your sum insured limit.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Medical expenses before hospitalization are covered for up to 90 days, which is better than the usual 30–60 days. This helps cover costs related to diagnosis and treatment before admission.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: We shall provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured (“Super Reload”), unlimited times during the Policy Year...
great.explanation: The policy allows unlimited reloads of the base sum insured during the policy year after it is exhausted, starting from the second claim. This gives you extra coverage if you have multiple claims.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: an additional limit under the current Policy Year (“Super Credit”) will be applied / increased... irrespective of any claims in previous Policy Year
great.explanation: Extra sum insured is added on renewal regardless of claims made, providing additional coverage beyond the base sum insured. This benefits you by increasing your coverage even if you have claimed before.

great.name: NCB
great.explanation: The renewal bonus (Super Credit) does not reset to zero after a claim and increases regardless of claims. This means your sum insured can grow even if you make claims.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: Claim Protect (Non-Medical Expense Waiver): Non-payable items will be covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP+); also Section C.4
great.explanation: If Claim Protect is active, common non-medical hospital items like gloves and masks are covered instead of being out-of-pocket. This reduces your incidental expenses during hospitalization.

great.name: Bariatric Surgery
great.quote: Obesity Treatment: Medical Expenses incurred... for a Bariatric Surgery... subject to the conditions that needs to be fulfilled as per Section D.1.6
great.explanation: Bariatric surgery is covered when you meet the policy’s medical criteria. This allows treatment for obesity-related conditions under the policy.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries / treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...
good.reference: Section D.1.2 Specified disease / procedure Waiting Period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: A 24-month waiting period applies for specified illnesses and procedures, which is standard in the market. You must wait two years before claiming for these conditions.

good.name: Initial Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered during the first 30 days except for accidents, which is a common industry practice. This protects against immediate claims on new policies.

good.name: PED Waiting
good.quote:
Pre Existing Disease (PED) Waiting Period
3 years
good.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP+), Waiting Period - Inbuilt Cover
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after a 3-year waiting period, which is within the acceptable 2–4 year range. This means you must wait three years before claiming for pre-existing conditions.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
bad.explanation: Post-hospitalization expenses are covered for up to 180 days, which is standard but not best-in-class. Expenses after 180 days will not be reimbursed, which may increase your out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: The expenses that are not covered... may be covered under this Product if Claim Protect (Non-Medical Expense Waiver) is applicable to You and mentioned in the Policy Schedule.
bad.reference: Annexure Summary; also Section C.4 / Annexure I context
bad.explanation: Non-medical consumable items are not covered by default and require Claim Protect to be active. Without this, you may have to pay for these items yourself.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment: means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the Policyholder / Insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
bad.explanation: The policy defines co-payment but does not specify if or when it applies for this plan. You need to check your Policy Schedule to know if any co-pay applies.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
